text:
maria: Quick update — I flipped the v2 route for /api/generate in prod (staged slices). handing off observability checks to ops now. link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/rls/v2-cutover-notes :tada:

frank: saw the canary, latency looks stable but a bit higher p99 in shard-3, watching.

lee: noted. which telemetry dashboards should ops focus on?

maria: short checklist I ran through -> 1) live 5xx rate per shard (expect <0.1%) 2) p50/p95/p99 token latency 3) model fallback counts 4) prober failures 5) error traces with header v1->v2 mismatch.

jess: adding: client-schema mismatch alerts (schema-regress) and embed/streaming regressions. also confirm release notes link is pushed to SDK repo.

deploy-bot: Canary job 3532100123 finished. traffic ramp: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over slices. No auto-rollbacks triggered.

ops-sre: taking handback. reassigning operator queue to @lee for next 30m. I'll run quick smoke on long-context streams.

lee: got it. first checks running: aggregate 5xx = 0.03% last 10m, p99 tokens +8ms vs baseline. tail latency spike at 10:12 on i-rtf-3 cluster. pulling traces.

frank: if spike correlates with KV cache misses, we should consider temporary shallow-quant fallback. how are cache-hit rates?

maria: cache-hit is ~92% overall but down to 78% for tenant slice eu-west-2. ixn with tenant warmup maybe.

ops-sre: traced the 10:12 spike to a single deployment pod that hit OOM and restarted — kube restarted it, replica restored. no request loss reported but led to a small queue increase.

jess: can we pin that pod's tenant routing out of the hot slice while we investigate?

maria: temporary routing shim applied for eu-west-2 -> routing flag set: code: ``deploybot route-shim --tenant eu-west-2 --to v1-shim``. Confirmed routing change went through.

deploy-bot: Route override applied for tenant eu-west-2. TTL=30m.

lee: re-run checks for eu-west-2: 5xx down to 0.01% and p99 back near baseline. good.

frank: decision note: keep the route-shim for 1h, ops will investigate pod OOM cause and either patch build or increase jvm heap on that config. rollback not needed currently.

maria: release notes updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/releases/tag/v2-cutover. please add any breaking client changes here.

jess: FYI — mobile SDK team reported a minor schema mismatch on streaming preface; they're cutting a patch now. if we see streaming client errors > 0.5% in next 20m, we auto-pin mobile tenants off v2.

ops-sre: set alert for streaming-preface-errors > 0.5% (20m window). I've also pinned the operator playbook in runbook channel.

lee: quick operator commands used this run (for records):
```
# check pinlist
deploybot pinlist --route /api/generate
# apply shim
deploybot route-shim --tenant eu-west-2 --to v1-shim --ttl 3600
# revert shim
deploybot route-shim --tenant eu-west-2 --remove
```

frank: good capture. after 1h ops will either remove shim or escalate to rollout rollback if we see regression persisting across 3 slices. rollback criteria: sustained 5xx > 0.5% for 30m OR streaming-preface-errors > 1% OR p99 tokens > +40% baseline.

maria: agreed. also logging the human approval flow: @frank or @maria to confirm before full rollback.

jess: tagging SDK leads @alex-mobile and @sam-server to sync patches.

alex-mobile: on it. will push mobile patch in 15m and coordinate canary.

ops-sre: operators, anyone taking deep-dive on the OOM root cause? @lee?

lee: I'll take it. initial signs point to a memory regression from recent native deps; collecting flamegraphs now. will update thread once found.

maria: thanks all. final ask — ops, keep the notated handback for 60m. if stable, we close this thread and remove temporary shims. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Note: remember to update the cutover dashboard docs with the shard id and pod id list. Recorded job id: 3532100123.

ops-sre: acknowledged. watching dashboard. will post closure message when we remove the shim or escalate.

lee: flamegraphs show libc bump in last image; opening PR to revert. will also queue a hotfix build to avoid pod restart churn.

maria: perfect. post-cutover owner: @lee for investigations, @jess for client communications, ops for handback until 3532100723. closing on positive unless alerts trigger. :lock:
